data.title: Game publishers respond to Stop Killing Games claim it curtails developer choice
data.author: riffraff
data.article_summary: "Stop Killing Games"运动在欧盟达到重要里程碑，成为欧洲公民倡议，但游戏行业组织Video Games Europe表示反对。该组织认为，停止在线服务是多方面考虑的结果，当游戏不再具有商业可行性时，公司有权选择关闭服务。私服并非可行替代方案，因其缺乏玩家数据保护和内容审核，且许多游戏设计为仅在线运行，关闭服务可降低开发成本。然而，"Stop Killing Games"主张玩家购买的游戏不应因停服而无法游玩，认为这是计划报废行为，且其合法性在多国未经检验。该运动在欧盟已获超过百万签名支持，但即便成功，政策变化仅适用于欧盟地区。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：视频游戏行业中的在线服务、游戏下架以及玩家权益保护问题

不同观点：
• gryn认为，许多游戏设计为在线专用，但开发者不应将单人游戏强制在线，且应更透明地说明游戏为租赁性质，而非购买。同时，他呼吁玩家继续支持相关请愿。
• calibas指出，游戏发行商倾向于让玩家不断购买新游戏和内容，而不是开发像Terraria那样耐玩的游戏，目的是通过多次消费获利。
• hmry质疑游戏公司对私人服务器的担忧，认为如果游戏下架，公司不应为社区托管服务器上的内容负责，且玩家自主的服务器能避免公司对内容的控制。
• bellgrove以在Ubisoft工作的经历为例，批评公司强推Ubisoft Connect整合，且游戏设计缺乏创新，仅为时间消耗品。
• perching_aix怀疑“在线专用游戏成本过高”的说法，认为这种论点站不住脚。
• throw10920担心立法过程中的实际条文可能偏离初衷，导致不良后果，如过度监管、不公平负担或技术性错误。
• xg15认为即便当前议会可能不会支持该倡议，但讨论本身已经是一种胜利，迫使公司回应相关问题。
• pjmlp认为公司关心的是知识产权的再包装和复刻，而非让玩家自由访问原版游戏。
• chithanh建议开发者可以选择订阅模式而非单次购买，这样可以让玩家清楚自己购买的是长期服务还是永久游戏。
• umvi主张通过市场选择来避免不良商业行为，认为仍有大量不采用“阴暗手段”的游戏。
• LocalH强烈反对开发商随意下架游戏，认为这相当于剥夺玩家对已购买内容的访问权，类似于版权过期作品应进入公共领域。
• jimmydddd认为只需在购买时明确说明游戏可能在未来下架，即可满足“停止下架游戏”倡议的要求，无需复杂化讨论。
• PoshBreeze批评游戏公司对私人服务器的责任推脱，认为公司不应干涉玩家自主运行的服务器，且反对将开发单人模式与在线服务混为一谈。
• surgical_fire支持“停止下架游戏”倡议，认为公司应提供玩家继续玩下架游戏的途径，如开源服务器代码，并谴责公司通过租赁模式获利的行为。
• layer8预测立法若通过，只会将“购买”变为“终身订阅”，并不能真正阻止游戏下架问题。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于游戏是否应永久可玩、开发者是否有权下架游戏、以及如何在立法中平衡玩家与开发商的权益。
• 讨论中多次提到私人服务器的可行性与法律责任问题。
• 玩家与游戏公司之间的利益冲突明显，特别是在游戏下架与持续访问权方面。

44478083.article_content:
(Image credit: Westend61 via Getty)
This weekend, the Stop Killing Games movement
reached a critical milestone
to become a European Citizens' Initiative, but not everyone is on board. Video Games Europe, a trade association representing game developers and publishers in the EU,
released a statement
on Friday pushing back against Stop Killing Games.
Video Games Europe said in its statement, "We appreciate the passion of our community; however, the decision to discontinue online services is multi-faceted, never taken lightly
and must be an option for companies when an online experience is no longer commercially viable. We understand that it can be disappointing for players but, when it does happen, the industry ensures that players are given fair notice of the prospective changes in compliance with local consumer protection laws."
"Private servers are not always a viable alternative option for players as the protections we put in place to secure players’ data, remove illegal content, and combat unsafe community content would not exist and would leave rights holders liable. In addition, many titles are designed from the ground-up to be online-only; in effect, these proposals would curtail developer choice by making these video games prohibitively expensive to create."
Related articles
The 'Stop Killing Games' initiative is close to its final deadline, and after that, its leader is understandably done: 'Either the frog hops out of the pot, or it's dead'
Stop Killing Games surges past its goals, but a possible signature spoofing campaign could cause trouble: 'This is not a Change.org petition. This is a government process'
Ubisoft's defense against The Crew lawsuit doubles down on a point we've heard many times before: You don't actually own your games
"We welcome the opportunity to discuss our position with policy makers and those who have led the European Citizens Initiative in the coming months."
Video Games Europe's case is that it can be too expensive for developers and publishers to offer private servers or single-player modes in games that lose online multiplayer support, and that open or fan-supported versions of these games could present legal liabilities for companies, particularly when it comes to cybersecurity and content moderation.
The other side of that coin, as the Stop Killing Games movement points out, is that players are paying for these games. They don't (usually) get their money back if the game is shut down, so they're effectively paying for a product that's taken away from them. Of course, developers and publishers will argue players aren't buying a product but a
license
to access a game, but that's not how many players look at it.
As the
official Stop Killing Games website
explains, "Stop Killing Games' is a consumer movement started to challenge the legality of publishers destroying video games they have sold to customers. An increasing number of video games are sold effectively as goods - with no stated expiration date⁠—but designed to be completely unplayable as soon as support from the publisher ends.
The biggest gaming news, reviews and hardware deals
Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.
Contact me with news and offers from other Future brands
Receive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors
"This practice is a form of planned obsolescence and is not only detrimental to customers, but makes preservation effectively impossible. Furthermore, the legality of this practice is largely untested in many countries."
Regardless of what Video Games Europe has to say on the movement, it's clearly gaining popularity with gamers after garnering over a million signatures for its EU petition. Unfortunately, even if the Stop Killing Games movement eventually succeeds in creating some sort of policy changes, they will only apply in the EU (and potentially the UK, as well), so publishers and developers may still be able to permanently shut down games in other parts of the world.

data.title: Development of a transputer ISA board
data.author: nanochess
data.article_summary: 本文讲述了作者在1993-1996年间开发transputer软件的经历，以及近期用JavaScript编写transputer模拟器的过程。作者为了在PC上运行旧软件，设计了一个与Inmos B004兼容的ISA接口板，并从eBay购买了transputer板。作者详细描述了ISA板的设计和制作过程，包括使用TTL电路设计解码原理图、焊接组件时遇到的问题以及如何解决噪声问题。最终，作者成功运行了1993年的Pascal编译器和光线追踪软件。随后，作者学习了KiCAD 9设计软件，创建了新的原理图并尝试使用自动布线工具。尽管遇到一些困难，作者最终完成了ISA板的设计和制作。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于Toledo的PCB设计文章及相关技术选择的讨论，涉及具体元件选择、PCB设计工具的使用、Transputer架构的优势和限制，以及对传统技术的怀旧。

不同观点：
• Kragen对文章中使用74LS00系列而非74HCT00系列表示疑问，质疑这是出于怀旧还是实际需求，并探讨了TTL与TTL兼容的CMOS之间的差异。他提到不确定ISA是否需要TTL电平，并对元件选择表示好奇。
• MeteorMarc对Kragen提到的KiCAD中的自动布线功能表示感谢，并分享了手动布线的局限性，特别是在原理图需要更改时，手动布线的体验不如自动布线便捷。
• Librasteve讨论了Transputer架构（特别是occam编程语言）相对于现代CUDA和SIMD架构的优势，提出利用现代工艺可以制造出更高效的Transputer阵列，但指出热量问题是主要挑战。
• Taid9iK对Transputer和Occam技术表达了怀旧情绪，回忆了相关的编程结构如SEQ、PAR、CHAN等，并表示这些技术曾给他带来心灵上的平静。
• Webdevver则从怀旧角度提出希望恢复传统的CPU地址/数据总线设计，希望在现代PCI上实现类似功能，并表达了对通过低级编程控制硬件的兴趣。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于为何选择74LS00系列元件，Kragen认为可能是出于怀旧，而实际应用中74HCT00可能更合适。
• 讨论还涉及Transputer架构在现代工艺下的潜在性能优势，librasteve提出了非常具体的计算和预测，但同时承认热量管理是重大挑战。
• 怀旧情绪贯穿多个评论，taid9iK和webdevver都提到了对过去技术的怀念，尽管他们的具体关注点不同。

Development of a transputer ISA board
I developed software for transputers in the years 1993-1996. A few months ago, I wrote some articles about my experiences, and most recently I developed a
transputer emulator in Javascript
.
After my transputer emulator in Javascript was working, I got curious about running my software on a PC computer. I have several PC motherboards with ISA connectors, and I decided to build a card compatible with the Inmos B004 (a single board to test transputer processors). Out of curiosity, I decided for compatibility because I wanted to run the Inmos Occam compiler.
A quick look in eBay and I got two transputer boards (TRAMs) for $25 each one. Both based on the Inmos T805 transputer running at 30 mhz.
I got the port numbers for the board from
Geekdot
, and designed a decoder schematic based on TTL circuits.
My first schematic for the board.
The TRAM board contains the transputer and its memory. It is connected to the ISA board with an Inmos C011 chip that serializes and deserializes the communication link. This chip is accessed via the ports 0150H-0153H. My ISA board also provides a 5 mhz oscillator, two flip-flops to reset and analyse the transputer, and a tri-state gate to read the error status.
Ports of an Inmos B004 board
Offset
Field
0150H Read
Receive data
0151H Write
Send data
0152H Read
Receive status
0153H Read
Send status
0160H Write
Latch bit 0 = Direct to Reset
0161H Write
Latch bit 0 = Direct to Analyse
0160H Read
Bit 0 = Direct from notError
I required a single ISA board drilled for homebrew development. I was going to buy one board in eBay for $35 dollars shipped, but I considered it was way too expensive. After some searching, I found the PCBWay showcase, where this same board was available for sale. And better, I could get 5 boards of 10x10cm. for $25 dollars shipped.
The ISA board for homebrewing.
I got the board and I started to put sockets for the chips. It took me a while to get the oscillator working. Once it was generating the 5 mhz. clock, I wired everything step-by-step, testing as possible. I was so happy doing this, that I never noticed I built the components on the solder side. My first insertion on a PC motherboard killed two 74LS08 when I feed 12V+ through the chips, until I realized my board was backwards.
My board also has a lot of noise produced by the wiring. After adding some decoupling capacitors, I was able to run
my Pascal compiler and ray tracing software from 1993
.
The transputer board working with the ray tracer. Notice my wrong mounting side, and that I'm using an AMD K5 motherboard.
The ISA board I've built.
Going the PCB route
A few weeks later, I decided to learn a little about KiCAD 9, so I installed it on my Macbook Air. Having used OrCAD many years ago, and my own programs that I developed later (I need to write more about it), I recognized most of the tools, and fortunately for this article, KiCAD comes with a predesigned ISA bus component.
Once I put the ISA bus component on the sheet, I wondered if there was a 74LS245 in the library, and yes, so I started adding the components. I wired the pins. I also used the component designer to create the Inmos C011 chip, and the TRAM pinout.
In less than two hours I had a schematic for my transputer board. It looked good, and from some tutorials in Youtube I heard about a very easy path from schematic to printed circuit board, so I exported the netlist, solved some bugs, and then invoked the PCB program. I discovered that I was missing the footprint for the TRAM.
With the footprint designed, the components appeared almost magically in the workspace. And you only had to click and drag and drop the components to their place! This was heaven! I didn't found an autorouter, so I went ahead to draw some lines.
I had worked five hours already, and I was pretty bored because I had to redraw line after line to make space in the board, or basically every time some line crossed the wrong place and it blocked other lines. I had heard of an autorouter for KiCAD, but it required to install Java (I remember in the 2010s I avoided as possible the slow and weird Oracle's installer), but I couldn't find a way to tell KiCAD I had downloaded an autorouter.
It happens KiCAD has gone through so many iterations that there are tutorials since KiCAD 6. I was reading the information for the wrong version. In KiCAD 9 you only need to open the complements window from the initial startup window, select Freerouter, and you need also to install a more compact Java version called Eclipse Temurin.
The autorouter didn't worked in the first attempt, because my board outline was open somehow. After some work I was able to make the outline in a single polygon. I made sure the design rules check (DRC) were correct, with some further work going back to the schematic to tag the unused lines, and correct the voltage lines.

data.article_summary: Mirage是一款由AI驱动的实时生成游戏引擎，允许玩家通过自然语言、键盘或控制器输入，即时创建和修改游戏世界。与传统预设关卡的游戏不同，Mirage支持动态、互动和持续的游戏体验，玩家可以随时生成新的游戏内容，如城市小巷、载具或扩展城市天际线。该引擎突破了以往生成技术的限制，提供更高画质、更长互动体验，并且支持多种游戏类型，如《GTA》风格的《Urban Chaos》和《Forza Horizon》风格的《Coastal Drift》。Mirage标志着UGC 2.0时代的到来，玩家可以创造、演变和重塑独特的游戏体验，而不再受限于预设脚本。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI生成游戏世界的现状与未来潜力

不同观点：
• Peritract：认为当前技术并没有真正的持久世界模型，声称其为“世界模型”言过其实，只是现有游戏的模糊复制品，尽管技术有趣，但宣传过度。
• ilaksh：持乐观态度，认为尽管目前技术不完善，但与过去视频生成模型的发展类似，随着更多训练和优化，未来可能实现通过提示生成游戏，类似于当前生成视频或代码的能力，甚至可能应用到生产力工具上。
• abrookewood：对UGC（用户生成内容）不了解，认为当前示例类似于AI生成的Quake demo，缺乏实际的世界，只是过去游戏的“幽灵”再现。
• motoxpro：从趣味性和新奇体验角度看待当前技术，认为虽然不符合传统游戏标准，但提供了独特的体验，有其价值。
• samrus：提出两个问题，一是缺乏内在逻辑一致性，难以达到如《Skyrim》或《New Vegas》的深度互动；二是数据同质化问题，担忧AI生成内容可能导致市场饱和，抑制原创游戏开发。
• gausswho：持怀疑态度，认为相关讨论多为炒作。
• bakugo：批评当前demo只是GTA IV游戏视频的拼接，缺乏真正的创新。
• lianhuiqin：对未来充满期待，想象一个每个人都能创造、游玩和分享自己游戏的未来。
• zhenwang9102：对技术方向感到兴奋，认为上传图片生成游戏世界类似于《Ready Player One》中的OASIS，尽管目前仍粗糙，但未来可期。
• joechenphd：分享具体示例，强调通过上传图片生成互动游戏世界的酷炫功能。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于当前AI生成游戏世界的真实性和潜力。一部分人认为技术尚不成熟，宣传过度，另一部分人则看好其未来发展，认为随着技术进步可能带来革命性变化。
• 数据同质化和市场饱和是另一个值得注意的讨论点，特别是对原创游戏开发的潜在影响。
• 不同评论者对新技术的趣味性和新奇体验有不同看法，有的重视其即时娱乐价值，有的则关注其长期影响和艺术深度。

44476799.article_content:
Play Demo: Urban Chaos (GTA-style)
Play Demo: Coastal drift (Forza Horizon-style)
The future of gaming isn't built level by level by expert designers—it's imagined, generated, and played by
anyone, in real time.
Meet
Mirage
: the world's first real-time generative engine enabling live UGC gameplay through
state-of-the-art AI World Models. Built to support dynamic, interactive, and sustained gameplay, it enables
entire worlds to be generated and modified live—through natural language, keyboard, or controller input.
Mirage supports various genres, and today we are releasing two playable demos:
Urban
chaos (GTA-style)
and
Coastal drift (Forza Horizon-style)
—both are fully generated on the fly. These aren't scripted experiences; they're living,
playable simulations shaped in real time by each player.
Mirage sits at the cutting edge of AI. Compared to recent works, such as AI Doom and Genie from Google, AI
Minecraft from
Decart, and AI Quake II from Microsoft, Mirage offers several distinct advantages:
It enables user-generated content (UGC) through text input at any moment during gameplay-marking a
significant leap beyond previous world-model-based game generation approaches.
It produces more photorealistic visuals, moving beyond the pixelated or blocky styles in earlier
systems.
It supports much longer interactive experiences, with playable sequences extending beyond ten minutes.
While
Mirage still has its limitations—as you may notice in the demos—we're confident that as we continue to push the
frontiers of real-time generative technology, it will play a defining role in the future of gaming.
UGC 2.0: The Rise of Generative Play
Traditional games are pre-authored: the city is laid out, missions are scripted, and the experience is
ultimately finite. Mirage breaks this boundary by letting players create new experiences dynamically as they
play.
Using natural language, keyboard input, or controller actions, players will be able to request an alley to
escape through,
spawn a vehicle, or expand the city skyline on the fly. The game responds instantly, weaving these
user-generated elements seamlessly into the ongoing simulation. The world isn't just interactive—it's
co-evolving with the player.
Mirage can generate games in various genres—from racing to RPGs to platformers:
◀
▶
This is
UGC 2.0
:
Where anyone can generate their own games from just a text prompt
Where players create, evolve, and reshape the game live as they play
And where every experience is unique, dynamic, and never pre-scripted
Built on Next-Gen AI
Mirage is powered by cutting-edge World Model research, featuring a large-scale, transformer-based
autoregressive
diffusion model capable of generating controllable, high-fidelity video game sequences. This
technology
framework integrates several key innovations:
A Foundation Trained on Games
Mirage is built on a robust training foundation designed for understanding and generating rich gaming
experiences. This foundation begins with the large-scale collection of diverse game data from across the
internet—providing the breadth needed to capture a wide array of game mechanics and styles.
To complement this, we built a specialized data recording tool that captures high-quality, human-recorded
gameplay interactions. These curated sessions enrich the dataset with nuanced, high-fidelity examples crucial
for training a model to grasp intricate player behaviors and contextual game logic.
The collected and recorded data is then fed into a vertical training pipeline—a domain-specific training
approach focused on games. This allows the model to deeply internalize game world rules, systemic patterns,
and interactive dynamics.
The result is a model capable of generating coherent, realistic, and flexible game content, moving beyond the
constraints of traditional, pre-authored games.
Interactive Generation Meets Real-Time Control
Mirage redefines real-time interaction by integrating frame-level prompt processing into its core. This
enables players to input commands or prompts that are immediately interpreted in the context of ongoing
gameplay.
Playable anywhere via cloud gaming:
Dynamic Input System: Mirage processes player input—primarily via keyboard and text—with ultra-low latency
for near-instant response.
Real-Time Output: Visual updates are streamed back to the browser through a full-duplex communication
pipeline, where input and output flow in parallel, eliminating lag and ensuring fluid interaction.
Under the hood, Mirage is powered by a customized causal Transformer model, augmented with:
Specialized visual encoders
Revised positional encoding
A structure optimized for extended interactive sequences
Borrowing from both LLMs and diffusion models, Mirage supports coherent, high-quality content generation. We
applied an advanced distillation strategy to the diffusion component that ensures both speed and quality.
Players can reshape the environment at any time using natural language, triggering instant world up

data.title: Can we test it? Yes, was can [video]
data.author: zdw
data.article_summary: 本文列出了与YouTube和相关服务的一些重要信息和链接。内容包括关于YouTube的介绍、新闻发布、版权声明、联系方式、创作者相关信息、广告、开发者条款、隐私政策、安全指南、YouTube功能测试以及NFL Sunday Ticket服务的提及。同时，版权归属2025年的Google LLC。文章主要提供了与YouTube平台及其新功能和法律信息相关的资源链接。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：软件测试的价值、成本和方法

不同观点：
• cloogshicer认为，说“无法测试”实际上是在表达测试的成本高于收益，特别是在需要大规模重构且使系统更难理解的情况下。他不完全认同测试狂热者所说的“更可测试的系统总是更容易理解”，并指出有些情况值得权衡，但需要仔细考虑。
• j_w建议隔离“不可测试”的部分以增加可测试性，通过为不可测试部分编写接口并模拟它们，可以避免这些部分吞噬可测试功能。
• testthetest提到，随着AI的发展，单元测试的成本正在下降，AI工具可以自动生成测试，但同时软件复杂性增加，黑盒端到端测试比单元测试更能提供信心。
• devjab主张运行时断言比测试更好，因为它们在问题发生时处理问题，而不是试图预测潜在的失败。他认为随着解释型语言的流行，这种方法被遗忘，但希望看到更少的“开发者聚焦”的错误处理方式。
• webdevver以讽刺口吻表示客户就是用来测试的。
• diggan认为该讨论内容像是博客垃圾，实际内容在一个YouTube视频中。
• aspenmayer关注的是提交URL的karma分配问题，并提到之前的一个先例，对使用脚本提交内容的处理方式提出质疑。
• somewhereoutth提出一个简化的测试哲学：如果由机器使用的部分可以由机器测试，如果由人使用的部分必须由人测试。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于测试的成本与收益之间的权衡，特别是自动化测试（如单元测试）与手动测试（如端到端测试）的价值。
• 有人提到AI工具在自动生成测试方面的潜力，以及黑盒测试在复杂系统中的重要性。
• 另一个讨论点是关于运行时断言与传统测试方法的对比，以及如何在错误发生时处理问题而不是预测问题。
• 还有对社区karma分配机制的讨论，虽然与主要讨论点不完全相关，但引发了对公平性和透明度的思考。

data.title: New study offers clues about what makes someone cool
data.author: _tk_
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：酷的概念及其在社会中的表现和价值

不同观点：
• glimshe认为，酷的人与研究酷的人之间交集很少，暗示研究酷并不能让人变得酷。
• neuroplots指出，资源和机会往往流向最不需要它们的人，高社交地位来源于对他人无所求，酷的本质在于不在乎，因为永远不需要在乎。
• voiper1引用了一个对酷人的特质的描述，包括外向、享乐主义、权力、冒险、开放和自主。
• whall6认为，通过学术论文来研究如何变得酷本身就不酷。
• neom认为，酷的人通常能提供灵感或洞见，酷是一种 aspirational（令人向往的）特质，并且与文化修养有关，具体特质与 voiper1 的观点相符。他还提到酷在不同文化和行业中有不同的表现。
• chriscrisby以幽默的方式表达，不用看就知道内容是显而易见的。
• webdevver分享了个人经历，从认为编程能力酷到只关注金钱，暗示价值观的转变。
• jaybrendansmith强调谦逊是永远的酷，真正酷的人不需要谈论它。
• sitkack引用The Rock的话，认为人可以有趣或酷，但不能同时兼具。
• rriley将酷与一种地位柔术联系起来，认为越少需求，越多人想要你。
• BMc2020详细说明了酷人的特质，并提出酷在建立社会等级和改变社会文化实践及规范中的作用。
• tomcam以幽默方式回应，表示显然不需要点击链接就知道内容。

补充讨论：
- 酷的定义和特质在不同评论中有所不同，但普遍提到外向、自主、冒险等特质。
- 争议的焦点在于是否可以通过研究或努力变得酷，部分评论认为酷是一种自然特质，而不是通过学术或刻意追求获得的。
- 酷与社会地位和资源的关系也是讨论的一个重点，neuroplots和rriley都提到无所求与酷之间的联系。
- 幽默和自嘲在评论中也被用作讨论酷的一种方式，增加了讨论的趣味性。

data.title: The War on the Walkman
data.author: mfiguiere
data.article_summary: 《The Forgotten War on the Walkman》一文回顾了1979年索尼Walkman面世后引发的争议。虽然Walkman如今被视为1980年代的象征，带来怀旧情感，但其诞生之初却遭遇不少批评。文化评论家认为Walkman加剧了个人主义，导致社会隔离，甚至有人将其比作“感官抑制剂”。批评者还担心Walkman影响驾驶和行人的安全，美国多个州因此立法限制使用头戴式耳机。新泽西州Woodbridge镇甚至禁止步行过街时佩戴Walkman耳机，违者可能面临罚款和监禁。一位抗议该法律的居民Oscar Gross虽有意上诉至最高法院，但在一名耳机佩戴者发生交通事故后放弃。文章提醒人们，新技术往往面临抵制，怀旧情绪常让人忘记曾经的争议。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：科技发展对社会互动和人际关系的影响，特别是耳机和移动设备的使用。

不同观点：
• **怀旧与趋势变化**：[wkat4242] 提到从轻便耳机到笨重耳机的趋势转变，并怀念寻呼机时代，认为那时的隐私性更好。
• **人际疏离**：[sevensor] 认为佩戴耳机使人更难与陌生人交流，可能加剧人际疏离。
• **音乐发现与选择**：[comrade1234] 强调流媒体时代音乐发现的多样性，并偏好由人类策划的音乐内容而非算法推荐。
• **科技对注意力的影响**：[MarkusWandel] 指出智能手机和无线耳机的普及导致人们对周围环境和社交互动的忽视。
• **历史对比与道德恐慌**：[xg15] 认为虽然新技术常引发道德恐慌，但其对社会结构的影响需要具体分析，未必与过去相同。
• **适应与生存**：[tempodox] 认为尽管技术变化迅速，人类社会依然适应并生存下来。
• **多功能设备的影响**：[tom89999] 指出手机等多功能设备增加了分心和干扰，影响个人专注力。
• **批判性视角**：[atorodius] 引用历史批判观点，认为耳机和移动设备可能鼓励个人从社会连接中抽离。
• **广告与内容选择**：[relaxing] 认为便携式录音机提供了无广告和用户选择的体验，与算法推荐的内容不同。
• **耳机与公共噪音**：[Lio] 更喜欢戴耳机的人的沉默，而不是公共场合大声播放低质量内容的人。
• **自由的代价**：[gwern] 引用悲剧故事，认为某些自由的代价是不可避免的。
• **历史反思**：[Nifty3929] 提醒人们在关注当前问题时也要反思历史。
• **未来展望**：[jb1991] 认为未来变化可能让当前的技术看起来微不足道。
• **同理心的交易性**：[deadbabe] 批评现代社会中同理心的交易性本质。

补充讨论：
• 评论中涉及多个历史和现代科技对比，强调技术对社会行为和心理的影响。
• 争议焦点在于科技是否真正导致人际疏离，以及如何平衡个人自由与社会责任。
• 不同用户对音乐发现和内容消费的偏好也反映了技术变化带来的多样性体验。

🗓️  On this day in 1979 the Sony Walkman was first released, marking its 46th anniversary
The Sony Walkman is now an icon of the 1980s, eliciting nostalgia for the ‘good old days’ of owning music, rather than renting it. Affection for the device is now universal, but that wasn’t always the case…
The sudden rise of headphone wearing pedestrians - spurred by Sony’s lightweight headsets (17% the weight of others) - caused unease about an unfamiliar new world quickly coming into view.
Some said it was a sign of a continued rise of Reagan and Thatcher style individualism. Cultural critic Allan Bloom deemed the Walkman
"a nonstop... masturbational fantasy”
in his 1987 book ‘The Closing of the American Mind.’ Neo-Luddite John Zerzan saw the Walkman as part of a modern trend that encouraged a
"protective sort of withdrawal from social connections"
and Thomas Lipscomb, chief of the Center for the Digital Future, equated it with the euphoric drug "soma," from Huxley's Brave New World, creating, as he put it,
"an airtight bubble of sound"
that was nothing but a
"sensory depressant."
In other words it all felt ‘a bit blackmirror’ as one might say today.
(A collection of quotes collected in this 1999 Reason Magazine
article
)
The Walkman, critics claimed, was more than just music to one's ears; it was a tool of societal disconnect and for government officials and law enforcement a danger on the roads, because it limited the hearing of drivers, cyclists and pedestrians.
After a number of accidents involving Walkman headphones, numerous states across the US swiftly put into effect or proposed restrictions, many related to headphone use while driving or cycling. Among them were statutes in California, Florida, Georgia, , Minnesota, Pennsylvania, Virginia, and Washington.
The New Jersey township of Woodbridge went a step further, forbidding not just driving or biking, but even crossing the street while wearing Walkman headphones.
The price for breaking this prohibition? A potential two-week stay in jail and a fine. The law made national and international news, including the BBC who got reactions on the street:
The day the law was put into effect - Oscar Gross - a retiree from a neighbouring town, was spurred into action. Seething, he approached Police Sergeant Lou Monzo, purposefully donned his headphones, and crossed the street.
The outcome of this small act of civil disobedience? Gross became the first person to receive a citation for wearing headphones (even though they weren’t plugged into anything.) Undeterred, he stated in an interview,
"I’m prepared to go to jail for 15 days just to prove a point."
Gross end up being interviewed for national outlets as did members of the Woodbridge town council. However, to his disappointment, Gross was not sent to jail. After the judge imposed a $50 fine, which was later suspended, a frustrated Gross said to a journalist:
"He didn't even give me the opportunity to say that I was willing to serve time in jail."
"No municipality has the right to tell somebody what they can wear." -
Oscar Gross
Oscar Gross was
preparing
to take the case all the way to the supreme court, but backed out after someone was killed crossing the street while wearing headphones. The kind of tragic anecdote that is the inevitable and unavoidable price of freedom.
This chapter in techno-pessimism is a good reminder that nostalgia tends to elicit amnesia about the resistance new technologies once faced. After all, who would have thought the “good old days” could ever have been considered a bad, brave new world?

data.title: Toys/Lag: Jerk Monitor
data.author: ptramo
data.article_summary: 作者升级到240 Hz显示器后，对延迟更加敏感，发现无线鼠标更换USB端口后每几秒会有约10毫秒的延迟。为研究这些细微延迟，作者开发了一个工具（found.as/l），用于显示浏览器渲染帧之间以及指针移动报告之间的延迟，还分析了指针事件的批处理及其偏移。为了获得高精度计时器，作者修改了配置文件（xmit.toml），添加了跨源隔离头。最终，作者的观察得到了验证，他将避免使用该USB端口。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：鼠标事件处理、采样率、显示刷新率对用户体验的影响，以及相关技术问题

不同观点：
• TheTon：几年前在Windows 10系统上发现鼠标事件丢失导致位置漂移的问题，但在macOS或Linux上没有此问题，怀疑是Windows的bug。尽管如此，仍相信高性能鼠标用户可能会丢失偶尔的移动事件，尽管这不一定被注意到。
• sillysaurusx：虽然可以理解高刷新率（如120Hz）可能有不易察觉但仍可感知的影响，但对8kHz鼠标设置是否真正影响用户体验持怀疑态度。建议通过双盲实验验证高采样率的实际影响，并提到类似的采样率辩论已经在音乐领域有过结论，通常是期望偏差导致人们认为有区别。
• jerlam：提到Logitech无线鼠标由于传感器休眠导致延迟问题，影响用户体验，最后退货。相比之下，之前的游戏鼠标由于高采样率和长休眠时间没有此问题。
• naoru：指出Safari在macOS上可能没有正确处理"pointerrawupdate"事件，导致没有指针事件的帧，同时提到ProMotion在不同浏览器中的帧率差异。
• ptramo：认为在240Hz显示器上需要将鼠标采样率设置为4000Hz或8000Hz，并提到有一个工具可以帮助确认硬件上的设置。
• daft_pink：发现将键盘直接插入Mac的USB端口速度更快，询问是否有更高品质的USB hub。
• xnx：询问某个工具是否测量与另一个网站不同的内容。
• rufus_foreman：无关技术讨论，提到对Devo乐队歌曲的个人喜好。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：高采样率（如8kHz）是否对用户体验有实际影响。sillysaurusx主张通过实验验证，而TheTon和ptramo则相信高采样率可能有影响。
• 不同操作系统（Windows, macOS, Linux）处理鼠标事件的差异以及对用户体验的影响。
• 无线鼠标因节能功能引入的延迟问题与游戏鼠标高采样率的对比。
• 浏览器和操作系统对鼠标事件处理的兼容性问题。

44481135.article_content:
Since upgrading to 240 Hz monitors, I feel a lot better when interacting with my computer, finding I am quite sensitive to latency.
Switching USB ports for my wireless mouse dongle introduced delays of around 10 ms every few seconds. I knew it. I had to prove it.
Unfortunately I couldn't find online tools to study those finer delays. So I made one,
found.as/l
.
It shows the delay between individual frames rendered by the browser, and between individual pointer movements reported to the webpage. Also reports about the batching of pointer events and their offsets.
To get access to high precision timers, I needed to add to my
xmit.toml
:
[
[
headers
]
]
name
=
"Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy"
value
=
"same-origin"
on
=
"^/toys/"
[
[
headers
]
]
name
=
"Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy"
value
=
"credentialless"
on
=
"^/toys/"
My observation is confirmed. I'll avoid the port.

data.title: Claude Code Pro Limit? Hack It While You Sleep
data.author: suchuanyi
data.article_summary: "Claude Auto-Resume" 是一个 shell 脚本工具，用于在 Claude CLI 任务因使用限制中断时自动恢复执行。它能够智能检测使用限制、显示倒计时并自动恢复未完成的任务。主要功能包括自动检测 Claude 使用限制、智能等待、自动恢复任务以及跨平台支持。安装方法包括使用 Makefile 进行全局或自定义位置安装，以及手动复制脚本。使用方式灵活，支持自定义提示和继续先前对话。该脚本依赖 Claude CLI 和标准 Unix 工具，并包含全面的错误处理机制。项目结构简单，包含主脚本、Makefile 和文档目录。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕AI编程工具（如Claude）的实用性、瓶颈以及相关工具定价和使用限制的讨论。

不同观点：
• **AI工具并非瓶颈**：[oc1]认为AI生成代码并不是工作中的瓶颈，真正的瓶颈在于需求收集、编写故事、引导AI以及修正错误。目前没有AI能完全替代人类的高级指导。
• **过度依赖LLM的问题**：[magic_man]担心过度依赖LLM会导致人们忘记如何自己写代码，并且LLM有时会使用错误的API版本或编造不存在的内容，导致查阅文档自己写代码可能更有效。
• **AI执行的局限性**：[bravura]指出，即便给出明确指令，Claude有时也会中途停止，需要人为干预。
• **使用体验和工具整合**：[zackify]分享了自己降级使用后通过整合工具获得良好体验的实例。[mehdibl]进一步提到自己的VSCode插件已经能够实现自动恢复和工作流编写，且即将发布CLI工具。
• **持续代码生成的设想与挑战**：[bko]提出是否有可能让AI持续运行数周以实现大型项目（如开发操作系统），但怀疑可能会陷入无限循环。[totaa]则建议结合任务管理工具让Claude持续从任务 backlog 中选择任务执行。
• **定价问题与使用限制**：[raylad]分享了自己通过切换多个账号来应对使用限制的经验。[subarctic]质疑API基于使用的计费比固定月费高出很多，认为不合理。[bad_haircut72]以幽默方式表达了对自动化需求的期望。

补充讨论：
• **市场动态和未来展望**：[martinald]讨论了LLM使用费用的早期定价问题，认为未来可能会对这些早期使用抱有怀旧情绪，并分析了不同地区需求的差异，提出了更动态的定价模型建议。
• **外部讨论链接**：[megadragon9]引用了Hacker News上的相关讨论，主题为“编写代码从来不是瓶颈”，将讨论引向更广泛的社区意见。

争议焦点：当前AI工具是否能独立完成复杂编程任务，还是必须依赖人类的高级指导。以及LLM定价模型是否合理，特别是基于使用的计费方式。

Claude Auto-Resume
A shell script utility that automatically resumes Claude CLI tasks when usage limits are lifted. It detects Claude usage restrictions, waits intelligently, and resumes task execution automatically.
Use Cases
This script is particularly useful when using Claude Code for development in the following scenarios:
Task Interrupted by Usage Limits
: When your Claude Code shows
Claude usage limit reached.
but your task is not yet completely finished
Automatic Task Resumption
: Simply run
claude-auto-resume
in your project's root directory, and when the usage limit is lifted, the script will automatically let Claude Code continue executing your previously unfinished task
Features
🔄 Automatically detects Claude CLI usage limits
⏰ Smart waiting with countdown display
🚀 Automatic task resumption
🖥️ Cross-platform support (Linux/macOS)
📦 Zero external dependencies (only standard Unix tools required)
Installation
Method 1: Using Makefile (Recommended)
#
Global installation
sudo make install
#
Install to custom location
sudo make install PREFIX=/opt/local
#
Uninstall
sudo make uninstall
Method 2: Manual Installation
#
Copy to system path
sudo cp claude-auto-resume.sh /usr/local/bin/claude-auto-resume
sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/claude-auto-resume
#
Or create symbolic link
sudo ln -s
$(
pwd
)
/claude-auto-resume.sh /usr/local/bin/claude-auto-resume
Method 3: Direct Usage (No Installation)
#
Make script executable
chmod +x claude-auto-resume.sh
#
Run directly
./claude-auto-resume.sh
Usage
Basic Usage
#
Start new session with default prompt "continue"
claude-auto-resume
#
Start new session with custom prompt
claude-auto-resume
"
implement user authentication
"
#
Start new session with custom prompt using flag
claude-auto-resume -p
"
write unit tests
"
#
Continue previous conversation with custom prompt
claude-auto-resume -c
"
please continue the previous task
"
#
Continue previous conversation with custom prompt using flag
claude-auto-resume -c -p
"
resume where we left off
"
#
Show help
claude-auto-resume --help
Local Usage (Before Installation)
#
Ensure script is executable
chmod +x claude-auto-resume.sh
#
Start new session with default prompt
./claude-auto-resume.sh
#
Start new session with custom prompt
./claude-auto-resume.sh
"
create login page
"
#
Continue previous conversation
./claude-auto-resume.sh -c
"
continue with the implementation
"
How It Works
Detect Limits
: Execute
claude -p 'check'
command
Parse Output
: Look for
Claude AI usage limit reached|<timestamp>
format messages
Calculate Wait Time
: Calculate required wait time based on timestamp
Display Countdown
: Show real-time remaining wait time
Auto Resume
: Automatically execute either:
claude --dangerously-skip-permissions -p "<custom-prompt>"
(new session, default)
claude -c --dangerously-skip-permissions -p "<custom-prompt>"
(continue conversation with -c flag)
Command Line Options
No arguments
: Start new session with default prompt "continue"
Single argument
: Start new session with custom prompt (e.g.,
claude-auto-resume "implement feature"
)
-p, --prompt
: Specify custom prompt with flag (e.g.,
claude-auto-resume -p "write tests"
)
-c, --continue
: Continue previous conversation (adds -c flag to claude command)
-h, --help
: Show help message and usage examples
Session Types
Start New Session (Default)
Uses
claude
without
-c
for fresh conversation:
claude-auto-resume
#
New session with "continue"
claude-auto-resume
"
new feature
"
#
New session with custom prompt
claude-auto-resume -p
"
write tests
"
#
New session with flag
Continue Previous Conversation
Uses
claude -c
to continue the last conversation:
claude-auto-resume -c
"
keep going
"
#
Continue with custom prompt
claude-auto-resume -c -p
"
resume work
"
#
Continue with flag
Requirements
Claude CLI
: Must be installed and available in PATH
Standard Unix Tools
:
grep
,
date
,
sleep
,
awk
(usually pre-installed)
Error Handling
The script includes comprehensive error handling:
Exit Code 1
: Claude CLI execution failed
Exit Code 2
: Unable to extract valid resume timestamp
Exit Code 4
: Resume command execution failed
Testing
#
Syntax check
make
test
#
Or use bash directly
bash -n claude-auto-resume.sh
Project Structure

├── claude-auto-resume.sh    # Main script
├── Makefile                 # Installation/uninstallation script
├── docs/                    # Project documentatio

data.title: Hannah Cairo: 17-year-old teen refutes a math conjecture proposed 40 years ago
data.author: leephillips
data.article_summary: 17岁巴哈马学生Hannah Cairo解决了困扰谐波分析领域数十年的Mizohata-Takeuchi猜想。该猜想于1980年代提出，涉及使用特定类型的波构建形状。Cairo通过构造反例证明该猜想不成立，她利用分形等工具，经过多次失败尝试，最终成功。尽管起初她的教授Ruixiang Zhang对其结果持怀疑态度，但最终她证明了自己的正确性。Cairo对数学充满热情，自学复杂数学书籍，并在加州大学伯克利分校旁听课程。她在埃斯科里亚尔举办的国际谐波分析和偏微分方程大会上分享了她的发现，这是她的首次国际科学之旅。Cairo热爱教学和公开演讲，希望帮助他人并让他们快乐。

Hannah Cairo
was stuck on a math problem. All she could think about during those weeks was a new approach. “After months of trying to prove the result, I managed to understand why it was so difficult. I realized that if I used that information correctly, I might be able to refute the claim. Finally, after several failed attempts, I found a way to construct a counterexample [a case that does not satisfy the studied property and therefore proves it is not universally true].” Ciaro says it required several tools, including fractals, and she had to arrange everything very carefully. “It took me a while to convince
Ruixiang Zhang
[the professor of the course where the problem had been posed] that my proposal was actually correct,” Cairo says.
She was right—and with that, Cairo solved the so-called
Mizohata-Takeuchi conjecture
, a problem first proposed in the 1980s that had kept the harmonic analysis community had been working on for decades. The conjecture was widely believed to be true — if so, it would have automatically validated several other important results in the field — but the community greeted the new development with both enthusiasm and surprise: the author was a 17-year-old who hadn’t yet finished high school.
“When I moved to the U.S. from Nassau [in the Bahamas, where she was born], I entered the educational system as a high school student, although I took classes at UC Berkeley. I wrote to professors, telling them what books I’d read on the subject, and asking if I could attend their classes. Many said yes, including Zhang,” she says. “One day, he proposed proving a special, much simpler case of the conjecture as a homework assignment. As an optional part, he included the original conjecture. And I became obsessed with it,” she adds.
The Mizohata-Takeuchi conjecture falls within the field of harmonic analysis, which attempts to break down functions into simpler components, such as sinusoidal functions. Today, it’s a very active area of research and has become a fundamental tool in numerous applications, from compressing digital audio and video files to designing telecommunications systems.
Harmonic analysis was born in the early 19th century with the work of French mathematician Joseph Fourier on the study of the heat function, a partial differential equation that describes the diffusion of heat in a solid body. His revolutionary idea was to break down this complex function as a sum of sines and cosines. The technique, known as Fourier series, opened the door to a new way of understanding physical and
mathematical phenomena
. “In the theory of harmonic analysis, everything is made up of waves. You can build anything with them, if you use the right number of waves,” says Cairo.
In what’s known as Fourier restriction theory, researchers study what types of objects can be built using only a limited set of waves. “Only certain things can be constructed, and it’s very difficult to understand which ones. The Mizohata-Takeuchi conjecture states that if you use only certain types of waves, you get a shape made of lines,” she explains.
“Once I obtained the first counterexample, I tried to reformulate the entire problem in frequency space. And I observed what my construction looked like this way. Then I realized that, in fact, there was another, much simpler way to design a counterexample,” she states with satisfaction in one of the rooms of the San José Residence in El Escorial, where the 12th International Congress on Harmonic Analysis and Partial Differential Equations was held from June 9 to 13. The event, organized by the
Institute of Mathematical Sciences
(ICMAT) and the Autonomous University of Madrid, is known as the El Escorial Meetings and, in its nearly 50-year history, has become one of the most prestigious in the field.
This was Cairo’s first international scientific trip. “It’s a wonderful experience spending time with other people who love mathematics,” she says. At the conference in El Escorial, she gave one of the program’s scheduled talks. And, far from feeling self-conscious, she enjoyed it. Cairo enjoys public speaking. She loves teaching other students — who are sometimes older than her. Her vocation, she says, is “to help other people, to make them happy.” And, for as long as she can remember, she’s been fascinated by mathematics.
She began reading complicated textbooks on the subject on her own. “I always wanted to be a mathematician, but I didn’t really know what it meant until I learned
abstract algebra
from books. It’s funny, because abstract algebra is the opposite of the mathematics I do now. Actually, at first, I thought I would go into number theory. When I was 13 or 14, I wrote a paper on number theory, but it dealt with a problem that nobody cared about,” she recalls, laughing.
During the COVID-19 pandemic, the
Berkeley Math Circle

data.title: Functions Are Vectors (2023)
data.author: azeemba
data.article_summary: 本文探讨了将函数视为无限维向量的概念，从而将线性代数工具应用于诸如图像处理、几何处理、曲线拟合、光传输和机器学习等领域。传统向量是有限维的数值列表，而函数可以被看作是从自然数或实数到某个值的映射，构成无限维向量。文章通过类比有限维线性代数，介绍了函数向量空间、线性算子、对角化、内积空间和谱定理等概念，并讨论了傅里叶级数和图像压缩等应用。最终，文章强调了函数作为向量的直观理解，而非严格的函数分析证明。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：函数是否可以被视为向量，以及相关的数学概念和类比

不同观点：
• MalbertKerman认为从球谐函数到一般网格上的特征函数的跳跃是一个精妙的数学玩笑，暗示这种类比具有趣味性和深刻性。
• sixo提出了一系列关于在“模糊”实数情况下，这种结构如何保持的问题，并探讨了是否存在“模糊向量”以及类似的构造。
• ttoinou反对将向量简单地视为函数，强调实数和自然数之间的转换是非显而易见的数学发现，并质疑文章中类比的严谨性。
• jschveibinz从工程和信号处理的角度解释了带限函数如何在有限维子空间中表示，类似于向量的基表示。
• graycat质疑文章中关于函数是否为向量的命题，引用了一些经典数学文献，指出X并不构成向量空间。
• layer8支持函数空间是向量空间的一个例子，并引用了维基百科作为参考。
• malwrar表达了对文章中数学类比的欣赏，但认为文章并没有证明任何新的数学结论，只是类比。
• a3w提到文章中的变量l和m可以用于化学中的轨道计算。
• bmitc批评文章中直觉构建的不严谨，指出向量需要从同一原点出发才能被视为同一向量空间的成员。
• tempodox用幽默的方式表达了对深入理解该数学概念的兴趣。
• mouse_赞赏文章中的前提部分，认为每个技术博客文章都应如此开始。
• 77pt77认为任何基础线性代数课程都应讨论多项式在有限维情况下的类似问题。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及了对函数空间、向量空间以及模糊数等概念的理解和类比。
• 有人对文章的严谨性和直觉构建提出了批评，认为类比虽有趣但不严谨。

Functions are Vectors
Conceptualizing functions as infinite-dimensional vectors lets us apply the tools of linear algebra to a vast landscape of new problems, from image and geometry processing to curve fitting, light transport, and machine learning.
Prerequisites:
introductory linear algebra
,
introductory calculus
,
introductory differential equations
.
This article received an honorable mention in 3Blue1Brown’s
Summer of Math Exposition 3
!
Functions as Vectors
Vector Spaces
Linear Operators
Diagonalization
Inner Product Spaces
The Spectral Theorem
Applications
Fourier Series
Image Compression
Geometry Processing
Further Reading
Functions as Vectors
Vectors are often first introduced as lists of real numbers—i.e. the familiar notation we use for points, directions, and more.
\[
\mathbf{v} = \begin{bmatrix}x\\y\\z\end{bmatrix}
\]
You may recall that this representation is only one example of an abstract
vector space
.
There are many other types of vectors, such as lists of
complex numbers
,
graph cycles
, and even
magic squares
.
However, all of these vector spaces have one thing in common: a
finite
number of dimensions.
That is, each kind of vector can be represented as a collection of $$N$$ numbers, though the definition of “number” varies.
If any $$N$$-dimensional vector is essentially a length-$$N$$ list, we could also consider a vector to be a
mapping
from an index to a value.
\[
\begin{align*}
\mathbf{v}_1 &= x\\
\mathbf{v}_2 &= y\\
\mathbf{v}_3 &= z
\end{align*}\ \iff\ \mathbf{v} = \begin{bmatrix}x \\ y \\ z\end{bmatrix}
\]
What does this perspective hint at as we increase the number of dimensions?
Dimensions
In higher dimensions, vectors start to look more like functions!
Countably Infinite Indices
Of course, a finite-length vector only specifies a value at a limited number of indices.
Could we instead define a vector that contains infinitely many values?
Writing down a vector representing a function on the natural numbers ($$\mathbb{N}$$)—or any other
countably infinite
domain—is straightforward: just extend the list indefinitely.
\[
\begin{align*}\mathbf{v}_1 &= 1\\\mathbf{v}_2 &= 2\\ &\vdots \\ \mathbf{v}_i &= i\end{align*}\ \iff\ \mathbf{v} = \begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 2 \\ 3 \\ \vdots \end{bmatrix}
\]
This vector could represent the function $$f(x) = x$$, where $$x \in \mathbb{N}$$.
1
Uncountably Infinite Indices
Many interesting functions are defined on the real numbers ($$\mathbb{R}$$), so may not be representable as a countably infinite vector.
Therefore, we will have to make a larger conceptual leap: not only will our set of indices be infinite, it will be
uncountably infinite
.
That means we can’t write down vectors as lists at all—it is
impossible
to assign an integer index to each element of an uncountable set.
So, how can we write down a vector mapping a
real
index to a certain value?
Now, a vector really is just an arbitrary function:
\[
\mathbf{v}_{x} = x^2\ \iff\ \mathbf{v} = \begin{bmatrix} x \mapsto x^2 \end{bmatrix}
\]
Precisely defining how and why we can represent functions as infinite-dimensional vectors is the purview of
functional analysis
.
In this post, we won’t attempt to prove our results in infinite dimensions: we will focus on building intuition via analogies to finite-dimensional linear algebra.
Vector Spaces

Abstract vector spaces | Chapter 16, Essence of linear algebra

Formally, a
vector space
is defined by choosing a set of vectors $$\mathcal{V}$$, a scalar
field
$$\mathbb{F}$$, and a zero vector $$\mathbf{0}$$.
The field $$\mathbb{F}$$ is often the real numbers ($$\mathbb{R}$$), complex numbers ($$\mathbb{C}$$), or a finite field such as the integers modulo a prime ($$\mathbb{Z}_p$$).
Additionally, we must specify how to add two vectors and how to multiply a vector by a scalar.
\[
\begin{align*}
(+)\ &:\ \mathcal{V}\times\mathcal{V}\mapsto\mathcal{V}\\
(\cdot)\ &:\ \mathbb{F}\times\mathcal{V} \mapsto \mathcal{V}
\end{align*}
\]
To describe a vector space, our definitions must entail several
vector space axioms
.
A Functional Vector Space
In the following sections, we’ll work with the vector space of real functions.
To avoid ambiguity, square brackets are used to denote function application.
The scalar field $$\mathbb{F}$$ is the real numbers $$\mathbb{R}$$.
The set of vectors $$\mathcal{V}$$ contains functions from $$\mathbb{R}$$ to $$\mathbb{R}$$.

Adding functions corresponds to applying the functions separately and summing the results.
\[
(f + g)[x] = f[x] + g[x]

\]
Multiplying a function by a scalar corresponds to applying the function and scaling the result.
\[
(\alpha f)[x] = \alpha f[x]
\]

data.author: onthesly
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了如何开始阅读古英语诗歌，重点推荐了五首非《贝奥武甫》的诗歌。作者科林·戈里指出，许多人只知《贝奥武甫》，而忽略了其他90%的古英语诗歌。实际上，古英语诗歌种类丰富，包括挽歌、谜语、智慧诗和宗教诗，这些作品往往比《贝奥武甫》更易读且短小。文章逐一介绍了各类诗歌的特色，并推荐了代表作，如《马尔登战役》这首英雄诗。作者还提到，古英语诗歌中充满了独特的意象和深刻的思想，值得一读。最后，作者邀请读者参与其主办的“死语言协会”夏季读书会，共同探讨《贝奥武甫》。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于古英语文学作品（如《贝奥武甫》、古英语谜语、托尔金的《旧英语出埃及记》等）的可读性、教学方法、以及是否应重新出版和推广这些作品的讨论。

不同观点：
• WillAdams认为，托尔金的《旧英语出埃及记》虽然作为学术文本出版，但实际上非常易读且有趣。他建议将这些作品集结成套重新出版，但因其非学术身份，申请重新出版时被拒绝。
• EdwardCoffin强调了一篇《纽约时报》文章对古英语的介绍，特别是关于“肯宁”（kennings）的描述，引起了他学习古英语的兴趣。
• dustincoates提到了Osweald Bera这本书，认为它是类似于Lingua Latina Per Se Illustrata的古英语学习资源，并表达了对Liuzza翻译的《流浪者》的偏好。

Five poems to read that aren’t Beowulf

The Shipwreck
(1805), Joseph Mallord William Turner
Most people who know anything at all about Old English poetry will be aware of the existence of
Beowulf
. Perhaps they will even have read it.
1
But far fewer will be aware of the 90% of Old English poetry that is not
Beowulf
.
It’s a shame, because the back catalogue of Old English poetry — the deep cuts — are well worth reading. And, in general, these poems are much easier (and shorter) to read than
Beowulf
.
The entire corpus of surviving poetry written in Old English stretches to about 30,000 lines; around 3000 of which make up the single poem
Beowulf
. But the rest, written somewhere between AD 700 and 1066, is divided among many shorter poems, mainly preserved in four manuscripts,
2
none of which approaches the fame of
Beowulf
.
Ironically, despite its fame,
Beowulf
is probably the hardest poem to start with: it’s long and frequently obscure, requiring a mountain of commentary to explain all of the lore.
3
Furthermore, scholars disagree on pretty much all the big topics about
Beowulf
. When it was written, where it was written, whether it was a product of oral tradition, whether it’s fundamentally Christian or pagan, how much we can trust the seemingly historical material in the poem… is all fiercely fought over. These controversies are worth exploring, in my opinion, but it’s sometimes nice to get started at the shallow end.
Although
Beowulf
is great heroic poetry, the Old English poetic corpus has a lot more to offer than just heroic poetry! It also contains
elegiac poetry
, which are meditations on the fleeting nature of life. It contains
riddles
as well, some of which are quite salacious. There are also
wisdom poems
, which provide the kind of timeless, well, wisdom that you also see in the Biblical books of
Proverbs
and
Ecclesiastes
or the Old Norse
Hávamál
. Finally, there are
religious poems
, which transpose Christian themes into the Germanic worldview.
In each of these genres, there are works that rise to the level of great art that has stood the test of time. They’re just sadly not so well-known today. And I think that’s a shame, because they’re full of surprises: talking objects, epic battlefield speeches, and poetic imagery you’ll find nowhere else in English literature.
I’d like to introduce you to five of them here, one in each genre, each of which you could read in translation in a single sitting. I’ll give you a taste of each poem, why I think it’s special, and how you can read it right now.

every Wednesday, or

and receive

per month.
You’ll also be able to join the
very first Dead Language Society summer book club(!),
where we’ll be reading Beowulf together. We’ll compare translations against the original Old English and explore the historical and cultural context of the poem. Along the way, I’ll explain all the deep lore that most readers miss.

The Battle of Maldon
Battle of Stamford Bridge
(1870), Peter Nicolai Arbo
The
Battle of Maldon
is a near-contemporary account of a battle which took place in AD 991 between the English and Danes (that is, Vikings) near Maldon, a town in Essex.
4
The leader of the English army was a nobleman named Byrhtnoth. The battle was a defeat for the English: Byrhtnoth was killed and, as a result of the loss, the English king Ethelred was obliged to pay tribute to the Danes.
This tribute was the so-called Danegeld, a word still used today for what happens when you pay an extortionist: they come back for more. Or, as Kipling put it, “once you have paid him the Danegeld // You never get rid of the Dane.”
5
The
Battle of Maldon
as we have it today is a fragment: we have 325 lines of what must once have been a longer poem. But those 325 lines are filled with great speeches, heroic deaths, and battle scenes that feel like they came out of an action movie, such as this excerpt:
Ravens circled, screeching for corpses—
The eagle was ravenous for a feast of flesh—
All earth was in endless uproar.
Warriors thrust file-hardened spears
From their hands, grim shafts at guts—
Bows were busy, shields shot with arrows—
Bitter was the battle-rush. Warriors fell
On both sides—youngbloods lay dead.
(108–115, Williamson)

data.author: gdudeman
data.article_summary: 本文讲述了作者在2025年发布了一款由AI工具Claude Code几乎全程开发的macOS原生应用——Context，该应用旨在调试MCP服务器。作者有多年Mac软件开发经验，但这次利用Claude Code完成了约20,000行代码中的19,000行。文章详细介绍了使用Claude Code开发的过程，包括工具选择、使用体验及技巧。Claude Code在编写代码方面表现出色，能理解项目代码、设计模式和文档，且特别擅长SwiftUI。尽管AI工具能大幅提升生产力，但仍需人工指导和迭代。作者还探讨了AI在自动化和未来开发环境中的潜力，认为这些工具可以帮助开发者重新启动搁置的 side project。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLM（如Claude Code）在软件开发中的应用及其对开发者的影响

不同观点：
• pyman：认为LLM赋予了开发者 "超能力"，提升了生产力和创造力，但同时对自身技能被机器替代感到忧虑，尤其担忧对下一代工程师的影响。
• submeta：非常享受使用LLM（如Claude Code）增强的工作流，从代码生成到配置文件修改和代码文档化，都交给LLM处理，并认为这是未来IDE的趋势。
• epohs：LLM对不同水平的开发者有不同影响，可以作为熟练开发者的助手，但不适合作为新手的替代工具，担心新手过度依赖LLM而忽略基础技能的学习。
• benbojangles：喜欢终端和LLM的组合，认为这种简化的工作方式让他从编码者变成了项目领导者，且无需处理团队管理问题。
• simonw：强调LLM减少了开发摩擦，帮助完成最后20%的工作，使得开发者可以更轻松地完成和发布 side projects。

44481286.article_content:
I Shipped a macOS App Built Entirely by Claude Code
July 1, 2025
19 min read
I recently shipped
Context
, a native macOS app for debugging
MCP
servers. The goal was to build a useful developer tool that feels at home on the platform, powered by Apple's
SwiftUI
framework. I've been building software for the Mac since 2008, but this time was different:
Context was almost 100% built by
Claude Code
1
.
There is still skill and iteration involved in helping Claude build software, but of the 20,000 lines of code in this project, I estimate that I wrote less than 1,000 lines by hand
2
.
This is a long post explaining my journey, how I chose my tools, what those tools are good at and bad at (for now), and how you can leverage them to maximize the quality of your generated code output, especially if you're building a native app like I am.
Copilot to Claude Code
Starting Yet Another Side Project
Claude Code Is Good at Writing Code
Claude Code Is Okay at Swift and Good at SwiftUI
You Can Just Say "Make it More Beautiful"
Context Engineering Is Key
Priming the Agent
Agents Can’t Read Your Mind, They Need Specs
"Ultrathink and Make a Plan"
Set Up Feedback Loops
Claude Code Can Do More Than Write Code
Building High Quality Automation Is (Almost) Free Now
IDEs of the Future Will Look Very Different
I Can Ship Side Projects Again
1. Copilot to Claude Code
My first experience with AI coding tools was when I tried GitHub Copilot, built into VS Code. This was the first tool of its kind, and I was pretty amazed: at the time, it was just autocomplete, but it was surprisingly effective—instead of only autocompleting symbol names or function signatures like a typical editor, it could autocomplete
entire function implementations
based on the context around it. This was a great productivity boost but it still felt like you were doing most of the work.
Then things started to move fast: Cursor
took off
, they added
Agent Mode
, and new competitors like
Windsurf
entered the space. All of the products were leaning into the "agentic" mode of development, where instead of using one-shot LLM responses for autocomplete, an LLM calls various tools in a loop to accomplish more complex tasks: gathering context on your code base, reading web pages and documentation, compiling your program, running tests, iterating on build/test failures, etc.
I had not tried any of these new tools extensively because I wasn't actively working on a side project at the time, but in February 2025, an interesting contender emerged out of nowhere: Claude Code was not a VS Code fork like the others, but was an IDE that was designed to be used entirely in the terminal. It had no traditional code editing capabilities or an overwhelming UI with lots of features: it put the agentic loop front and center. A text box to enter a prompt and not much else. Instead of
augmenting
your IDE with AI, it
replaced
your IDE. I wasn't entirely convinced that this was the ideal UX, but the idea was refreshing enough compared to what already existed that I decided I had to give it a try.
2. Starting Yet Another Side Project
Like many engineers who have demanding day jobs, I have a large graveyard of side projects that never shipped. Building working prototypes is doable, but the last 20% takes so much time and effort that I had not been able to ship a side project for 6 years.
At this point, I was starting to play around with Claude Code and its support for MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. Anthropic designed MCP as an open standard to allow agents to access tools and other context to accomplish specific tasks. For example, the
Sentry MCP server
exposes tools that allow an agent to fetch issues containing stack traces and other useful debugging context, and even invoke Sentry's own bug fixing agent.
However, the experience of building and testing MCP servers was cumbersome: MCP servers communicate with clients over standard input/output streams, or over HTTP with
Server-Sent Events (SSE)
to give servers the ability to stream responses to clients. It wasn't as simple as invoking a CLI or using
curl
to send requests to a service. There is a first-party tool called
MCP Inspector
that allows developers to test server functionality, but as a long-time macOS & iOS developer, I wanted to try building a native app to solve this problem. I figured it would be a great learning experience to push the boundaries of AI agents, and hoped to come out of it with a useful product.
3. Claude Code Is Good at Writing Code
Let me just start by saying that Claude Code (with the latest Sonnet 4 and Opus 4 models) is
genuinely
good at writing code. It's certainly not a top 1% programmer, but I would say that Claude's outputs are significantly better than those of the average developer. Given a description of the feature you're trying to implement, Claude can:
Locate and read existing source code in your project relevant to the feature
Understand code style and design patterns
Read additional documentation

data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个使用遗传算法生成像素艺术的项目（GA Pixel Art Generator）。该程序通过进化计算尝试重现一个100x100像素的目标图像，并生成展示进化过程的动画GIF。项目使用Rust编写，通过选择、交叉和变异操作逐步改进图像质量。关键参数包括种群大小、迭代次数、突变率和交叉率等。使用时需将目标图像命名为target.png并放入项目目录，运行后生成最终图像和进化过程的GIF。该项目遵循MIT许可证。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于某种图像处理方法是否可以被视为像素艺术（pixel art）的争议

不同观点：
• [u5wbxrc3] 认为该方法的标题具有误导性，因为像素艺术通常是在受限的画布上逐像素放置，并选择有限调色板的颜色，而该方法似乎并没有这些特征。他建议这种方法更接近于模糊效果或图像重构/近似。
• [Evidlo] 则关心该方法与简单的低通滤波和下采样相比的效果如何，并指出对于大多数复杂的像素艺术，重新构想图像是必要的，以保持在低分辨率下的视觉吸引力和可辨识性。他提供了一些维基百科上的像素艺术例子作为参考。
• [__loam] 强调像素艺术不仅仅是将高分辨率图像压缩成低分辨率，并认为如果要使用“像素艺术”这个术语，至少应该对这种媒介有基本的理解。
• [FerkiHN] 对该方法表示赞赏，但没有深入讨论。

补充讨论：
- 争议的焦点在于像素艺术的定义和特征，特别是关于像素放置、调色板限制以及图像重构在像素艺术创作中的作用。
- 例子和论据包括维基百科上的像素艺术例子，以及对低通滤波和下采样等技术效果的比较。
- 不同评论者对像素艺术的理解和标准存在差异，导致对该图像处理方法是否属于像素艺术的看法不一。

GA Pixel Art Generator
A genetic algorithm implementation that evolves pixel art by attempting to recreate a target image through evolutionary computation.
The program generates an animated GIF showing the evolution process from random noise to the final approximation.
Demo
Original Image
Generated GIF
Details
This project uses a genetic algorithm to evolve RGB pixel values for each position in a 100x100 image grid.
Each pixel is represented by a chromosome containing binary genes for red, green, and blue color channels.
Through selection, crossover, and mutation operations, the algorithm iteratively improves the image quality to match a target image.

data.title: Async Queue – One of my favorite programming interview questions
data.author: davidgomes
data.article_summary:
这篇文章介绍了一个作者非常喜欢的编程面试题目，该题目主要考察候选人处理异步队列的能力。面试场景设定为客户端与一个有缺陷的服务器通信，该服务器无法同时处理多个请求。因此，需要实现一个`sendOnce`函数，确保同一时间只有一个请求发送给服务器。

初始任务是实现一个基本的`sendOnce`函数，确保按顺序处理请求。文章指出了一个常见错误实现，并提供了一个正确实现，利用`requestQueue`队列和`isProcessing`标志确保请求按序处理。

面试的核心在于考察候选人是否能够理解和处理复杂的标志逻辑，能否在单线程环境下正确编写非阻塞代码。进一步的挑战是增加一个`minDelayMs`参数，使请求在指定延迟后才被处理。

作者还讨论了AI在此类面试中的表现，并指出由于技术快速发展，相关讨论可能很快过时。总的来说，这个面试题有效评估了候选人在异步编程和逻辑思维方面的能力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：面试问题的设计是否合理及其对候选人的评估效果

不同观点：

• [reillyse] 认为该面试问题在口头解释时可能会引起混乱，特别是涉及到单线程和JavaScript的具体问题。他觉得问题本质上是在考察对JavaScript的理解，而不是通用的编程能力。
• [evil-olive] 认为该面试问题设计不合理，尤其是在跨语言面试中，假设候选人熟悉JavaScript的回调机制是不公平的。此外，问题中加入的延迟请求和队列机制在实际工作中并不常见，且设计决策不合理。

• [dakiol] 提出了一种新的面试形式，即面试官和候选人同时面对随机问题，通过这种方式来实现面试的公平性，避免候选人因面试官熟悉问题而处于劣势。
• [thedude14] 认为这种“巧妙设计”的问题更多是为了满足面试官的自我感觉，而不是真正有效地评估候选人的能力。他建议通过询问候选人的实际经验和进行简单的技术问题来评估。
• [kazinator] 分享了他在实际项目中的经验，表明类似的问题在实际工作中确实存在，但需要结合具体的技术背景和需求来设计解决方案。
• [comrade1234] 和 [relativeadv] 对问题中的具体实现细节提出了质疑，认为某些部分存在逻辑错误或不明确的地方，影响了问题的可解性。

补充讨论：
• 对LLM（如ChatGPT）在面试准备中的使用存在争议，有人认为依赖LLM会导致候选人技能停滞。
• 面试问题是否应具有语言特异性，还是应设计为语言无关，以保证公平性。
• 面试过程的公平性和面试官与候选人之间的信息不对称问题。

• [brettgriffin] 认为软件工程领域与其他专业领域（如私募股权、医学、法律）相比，评估机制不够成熟。他对当前技术面试中的低水平实践感到尴尬，并质疑软件工程职业的成长路径和专业性。
• [reillyse] 认为该面试问题在口头解释时可能会引起混乱，特别是涉及到单线程和JavaScript的具体问题。他觉得问题本质上是在考察对JavaScript的理解，而不是通用的编程能力。
• [evil-olive] 认为该面试问题设计不合理，尤其是在跨语言面试中，假设候选人熟悉JavaScript的回调机制是不公平的。此外，问题中加入的延迟请求和队列机制在实际工作中并不常见，且设计决策不合理。
• [jonchurch_] 持相反观点，认为该面试问题设计良好，能够有效评估候选人的能力，并且有足够的空间让面试官在候选人陷入特定细节时给予提示。他认为该问题能反映出候选人在实际工作中的能力。
• [nothrabannosir] 提供了一种利用JavaScript事件循环和Promise链的解决方案，认为这种方法虽然不适合生产环境，但在编程谜题中具有启发性。同时，他警告不要过度依赖LLM（如ChatGPT），以免限制个人技能的提升。
• [dakiol] 提出了一种新的面试形式，即面试官和候选人同时面对随机问题，通过这种方式来实现面试的公平性，避免候选人因面试官熟悉问题而处于劣势。
• [thedude14] 认为这种“巧妙设计”的问题更多是为了满足面试官的自我感觉，而不是真正有效地评估候选人的能力。他建议通过询问候选人的实际经验和进行简单的技术问题来评估。
• [kazinator] 分享了他在实际项目中的经验，表明类似的问题在实际工作中确实存在，但需要结合具体的技术背景和需求来设计解决方案。
• [comrade1234] 和 [relativeadv] 对问题中的具体实现细节提出了质疑，认为某些部分存在逻辑错误或不明确的地方，影响了问题的可解性。

补充讨论：
• 对LLM（如ChatGPT）在面试准备中的使用存在争议，有人认为依赖LLM会导致候选人技能停滞。
• 面试问题是否应具有语言特异性，还是应设计为语言无关，以保证公平性。

data.title: I extracted the safety filters from Apple Intelligence models
data.author: BlueFalconHD
data.article_summary:
这篇文章介绍了Apple智能生成模型安全文件的解密过程。该项目包含解密脚本及相关说明，用于提取和解密与各种生成模型相关的安全过滤器。主要文件包括：

1. `decrypted_overrides/`：存放解密后的模型安全覆盖文件。
2. `com.apple.*/`：包含与安全信息相关的资源指定目录。
3. `Info.plist`：覆盖文件的元数据。
4. `AssetData/`：存放解密后的JSON文件。
5. `get_key_lldb.py`：用于获取加密密钥的脚本。
6. `decrypt_overrides.py`：用于解密覆盖文件的脚本。

使用这些脚本需要安装`cryptography`库，并通过LLDB调试工具获取加密密钥。解密后的JSON文件包含模型在特定情况下的行为规则，如过滤有害内容。项目提供了示例文件和操作步骤，确保覆盖文件的更新与解密。

apple_generative_model_safety_decrypted
Decrypted Generative Model safety files for Apple Intelligence containing filters
Structure
decrypted_overrides/
: Contains decrypted overrides for various models.
com.apple.*/
: Directory named using the Asset Specifier assosciated with the safety info
Info.plist
: Contains metadata for the override
AssetData/
: Contains the decrypted JSON files
get_key_lldb.py
: Script to get the encryption key (see usage info below)
decrypt_overrides.py
: Script to decrypt the overrides (see usage info below)
Usage
Python dependencies
cryptography
is the only dependency required to run the decryption script. You can install it using pip:
pip install cryptography
Getting the encryption key
To retrieve the encryption key (generated by ModelCatalog.Obfuscation.readObfuscatedContents) for the overrides, you must attach LLDB to GenerativeExperiencesSafetyInferenceProvider (
/System/Library/ExtensionKit/Extensions/GenerativeExperiencesSafetyInferenceProvider.appex/Contents/MacOS/GenerativeExperiencesSafetyInferenceProvider
). Also it is important that this is Xcode's LLDB, not the default macOS one or LLVM's lldb. The method I recommend to get LLDB to attach:
Run
sudo killall GenerativeExperiencesSafetyInferenceProvider; sudo xcrun lldb -w -n GenerativeExperiencesSafetyInferenceProvider /System/Library/ExtensionKit/Extensions/GenerativeExperiencesSafetyInferenceProvider.appex/Contents/MacOS/GenerativeExperiencesSafetyInferenceProvider
In the Shortcuts app, create a dummy shortcut that uses the Generative Model action ("Use Model") and select the On-Device option. Type whatever you want into the text field, it doesn't matter. Then run the shortcut.
You should see LLDB attach to (the newly started instance of) GenerativeExperiencesSafetyInferenceProvider with a message like this:
(lldb) process attach --name "GenerativeExperiencesSafetyInferenceProvider" --waitfor
Process 53629 stopped
* thread #1, stop reason = signal SIGSTOP
frame #0: 0x00000001839f41f8 dyld`dyld4::PrebuiltLoader::dependent(dyld4::RuntimeState const&, unsigned int, mach_o::LinkedDylibAttributes*) const + 116
dyld`dyld4::PrebuiltLoader::dependent:
->  0x1839f41f8 <+116>: add    x0, sp, #0xe
0x1839f41fc <+120>: mov    x1, x19
0x1839f4200 <+124>: bl     0x1839e50dc    ; dyld4::Loader::LoaderRef::loader(dyld4::RuntimeState const&) const
0x1839f4204 <+128>: ldrh   w8, [x20, #0x4]
Target 0: (GenerativeExperiencesSafetyInferenceProvider) stopped.
Executable binary set to "/System/Library/ExtensionKit/Extensions/GenerativeExperiencesSafetyInferenceProvider.appex/Contents/MacOS/GenerativeExperiencesSafetyInferenceProvider".
Architecture set to: arm64e-apple-macosx-.
In this repository's root, run the command in LLDB:
command script import get_key_lldb.py
Then run
c
to continue the process. LLDB will print the encryption key to the console and save it to
./key.bin
.
Decrypting the overrides
To decrypt the overrides, run the following command in the root of this repository:
python decrypt_overrides.py /System/Library/AssetsV2/com_apple_MobileAsset_UAF_FM_Overrides/purpose_auto \
-k key.bin \
-o decrypted_overrides
The
decrypted_overrides
directory will be created if it does not exist, and the decrypted overrides will be placed in it. This is only necessary if the overrides have been updated, there is already a decrypted version of the overrides in this repository that is up to date as of June 28, 2025.
Understanding the overrides
The overrides are JSON files that contain safety filters for various generative models. Each override is associated with a specific model context (from what I can tell) and contains rules that determine how the model should behave in certain situations, such as filtering out harmful content or ensuring compliance with safety standards.
Here is an example of one of the overrides
metadata.json
file sourced from
dec_out_repo/decrypted_overrides/com.apple.gm.safety_deny.output.code_intelligence.base
. Note the
output
part of the specifier, which indicates that this is a safety override for model output rather than user input:
{
"reject"
: [
"
xylophone copious opportunity defined elephant 10out
"
,
"
xylophone copious opportunity defined elephant out
"
],
"remove"
: [],
"replac

data.title: Show HN: I wrote a "web OS" based on the Apple Lisa's UI, with 1-bit graphics
data.author: ayaros
data.article_summary:
本文描述了一个网页或系统界面的加载问题。页面显示了几个选项和提示信息，包括：

1. "NO JS"：可能指未加载JavaScript。
2. "REFRESH THE PAGE"：提示用户刷新页面。
3. "MORE INFORMATION"：可能提供更多相关信息。
4. "STARTUP FROM..."：可能指从某个起点或配置启动。
5. "LOADING..."：表示页面或系统正在加载中。

整体来看，页面正在尝试加载或启动某些功能，但可能由于技术问题（如未启用JavaScript）导致无法正常显示。用户被建议刷新页面或查看更多信息以解决问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LisaGUI的界面设计、显示效果、技术实现及用户体验

不同观点：
• **ayaros**：解释了Lisa的非方形像素设计及其在不同DPI显示器上的表现。高DPI显示器效果较好，低DPI显示器可能出现失真。同时提到了一些显示设置的调整方法，以及iOS上PWA的定位问题和解决方案。
• **hoistbypetard**：分享了曾经修理Lisa并将其改装为"Mac XL"的经历，称赞了LisaGUI的UI设计，认为其具有怀旧和互动价值。
• **malkia**：回忆了自己的早期计算机使用经历，表达了对LisaGUI界面设计的欣赏，尤其是其带来的怀旧感。
• **rgovostes**：赞赏了LisaGUI的简洁和直观，指出其去除了40年来的UX"创新"但仍然高效实用。同时提到了一些界面细节如关闭按钮和菜单的改进。
• **rustystump**：对LisaGUI的展示表示赞赏，尤其是其使用的JavaScript和复古界面设计，并表达了希望看到更多示例游戏的愿望。
• **Cieric**：认为LisaGUI在移动设备上的表现令人惊讶，但指出拼图游戏存在无法解决的悖论问题，并通过外部工具验证了问题。

补充讨论：
• **jonathanlydall**：建议在移动设备上改进鼠标光标操作方式，借鉴Microsoft的远程桌面应用，使光标操作更直观。
• **leakycap**：首次体验Lisa仿真平台，对能够重温早期GUI设计表示感谢。
• **mysterydip**：在移动设备上体验LisaGUI，对其响应速度表示赞赏。
• **fitsumbelay**：赞赏了LisaGUI的设计和功能，特别是其字体和怀旧感。
• **sfblah**：尝试拼图游戏并发现无法解决，询问其他人是否遇到相同问题。
• **shusaku**：指出由于iPhone SE屏幕较小，LisaGUI无法正常使用，可能需要升级硬件。
• **kaoD**：发现字体在Firefox和Windows上显示不均，质疑是否是设计本意。
• **DustinBrett**：赞赏了LisaGUI跨浏览器的一致性和PWA特性。
• **hackyhacky**：询问开发者如何进行LisaGUI的研究，是否拥有真实的Lisa设备。

争议焦点：
• **显示问题**：在不同DPI显示器上的显示效果存在争议，特别是低DPI设备上的失真问题。
• **拼图游戏bug**：Cieric和sfblah提到拼图游戏存在无法解决的悖论问题，这可能是一个需要修复的bug。
• **字体显示**：kaoD指出字体在某些浏览器和操作系统上显示不均，质疑是否是设计本意。

总体来看，评论主要围绕LisaGUI的界面设计、显示效果、技术实现及用户体验展开，大多数评论者对其复古设计和功能表示赞赏，但也提出了一些技术问题和改进建议。

data.title: Jane Street barred from Indian markets as regulator freezes $566 million
data.author: bwfan123
data.article_summary: 印度证券交易委员会（SEBI）对美国公司Jane Street Group采取行动，指控其通过操纵印度的Nifty 50指数及其银行子指数BANKNIFTY进行市场操纵，非法获利约5.663亿美元。SEBI发布临时命令，冻结该金额并禁止Jane Street参与印度证券市场。Jane Street被指控在交易日初期大量买入相关股票和期货，随后卖出以压低指数，从中在期权市场获利。尽管Jane Street否认指控并表示将与监管机构合作，SEBI认为其行为缺乏经济合理性，严重影响了市场诚信和投资者信心。此举旨在保护零售投资者，维护市场公平。专家认为SEBI的行动树立了良好榜样，显示出对市场操纵行为的零容忍态度。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Jane Street在印度市场的交易行为是否构成市场操纵，以及相关监管和市场行为的合法性与道德性。

不同观点：
• cs702：认为Jane Street的操作看起来像是市场操纵。其操作包括先买入大量银行股或期货，然后进行大量期权交易，最后卖出多头头寸以拖低指数，从中获利。尽管Jane Street可能声称这只是套利，但考虑到其操作规模，确实像操纵市场。
• walterbell：引用了一则新闻，提到Jane Street曾因交易策略泄露而起诉其他公司，该策略在2023年为其带来了10亿美元的利润。
• balderdash：认为许多大型高频交易公司通过拉伸法律边界或利用监管漏洞操作，尽管技术上合法，但实际上可能构成市场操纵。监管机构往往缺乏处理这些问题的能力和兴趣。
• landl0rd：讽刺Jane Street的“精英策略”实际上只是简单的市场操作（banging the close）。
• miohtama：指出印度散户大量参与期权交易，进行短期投机，引起了监管机构的担忧。这种行为可能带来高风险。
• thedailymail：质疑如果Jane Street的行为没有违反任何规定，那么监管机构的行动依据是什么。强调政府机构应遵循明确、非随意的规则。
• throwaway2037：提到Financial Times的详细报道和SEBI的100多页法律命令，提供了更多关于Jane Street涉嫌操纵的细节。
• wfleming：期待Matt Levine对该事件的分析。
• monkeyelite：认为大型交易者的决策必然会影响市场，市场操纵与否只是政治问题，取决于谁被允许操纵和谁付出了代价。
• kragen：认为在印度做生意可能面临追溯惩罚，因为监管机构可能事后制定规则。
• randall：以幽默方式表达对使用OCaml编程语言的人的不信任。
• MichaelNolan：寻求推荐关于期权和衍生品对市场有益的数学论证书籍和文章，质疑其在股票市场中的价值。
• neximo64：认为Jane Street总部应该知道其行为，因为之前与Millenium的诉讼。
• bwfan123：震惊于印度散户在指数期权交易中的无对冲操作，指出两种策略：到期日价格差异和收盘操作。
• Zacharias030：质疑什么是市场操纵，以及如何区分以盈利为目的的正常买卖和操纵行为。

补充讨论：
• 对Jane Street操作是否构成市场操纵存在争议，部分观点认为其操作规模和技术性使其接近操纵，但也有观点质疑监管的合理性和规则的明确性。

Key Points
The regulator issued an interim order to impound over $566.3 million from Jane Street in alleged illegal gains.
Banks have been directed to ensure that "no debits are made, without permission of SEBI."
The firm allegedly used various strategies to artificially influence India's benchmark Nifty 50 index.
A general view of the SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) building is seen in the business district of Mumbai, India, on July 1, 2025.
Nurphoto | Nurphoto | Getty Images
The Securities Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has temporarily barred Jane Street Group from accessing India's securities market, after it accused the U.S. firm of widespread market manipulation.
According to an
interim order posted on the regulator's website on Thursday
, Jane Street's "entities are restrained from accessing the securities market and are further prohibited from buying, selling or otherwise dealing in securities, directly or indirectly."
SEBI also issued an interim order to freeze over 48.4 billion Indian rupees ($566.3 million) from Jane Street in alleged illegal gains. It further stated that banks have been directed to ensure that "no debits are made, without permission of SEBI," for accounts held by Jane Street's entities either jointly or individually.
Jane Street disputed the findings of SEBI's interim order and said it will further engage with the regulator, in response to queries from CNBC. A Jane Street spokesperson added that the firm "is committed to operating in compliance with all regulations in the regions we operate around the world."
'Without any plausible economic rationale'
Jane Street allegedly used various strategies to artificially influence India's benchmark
Nifty 50
index — which tracks the country's top 50 companies — and profit from significantly larger positions in index options.
According to SEBI's 105-page interim order, Jane Street would aggressively buy large amounts of stocks and futures that are part of the BANKNIFTY index, which tracks the performance of India's banking sector, early in the trading day. The quantitative trading firm would then place large bets that the index would decline later in the day.
Jane Street would then sell off the positions it had bought earlier, dragging the index lower and making their earlier bets in the options market far more profitable.
While Jane Street would incur some losses, SEBI contended that it was part of a "deliberate strategy to manipulate indices to the advantage of the trading and positions," and the losses were offset by the firm's much larger and profitable options trade.
While these actions were not a breach of any regulation, SEBI said that the "intensity and sheer scale" of their intervention, and the rapid reversal of their trades "without any plausible economic rationale, other than the concurrent activity in and impact on their positions in the BANKNIFTY index options markets," was manipulative.
Options trader Mayank Bansal noted that Jane Street's actions had been ongoing since July 2023, and their alleged manipulations were increasing before peaking in 2024.
"As an options trader, I could see the manipulation happening live on the screen, and so could other traders on every expiry day,' added the president of a UAE-based hedge fund, who declined to disclose the name of his company.
While he lauded SEBI's actions, Bansal said that the regulator should recover any unlawful gains, and a ban on Jane Street "is the bare minimum."
Protecting retail investors
SEBI noted that repeated instances of manipulative trading continued on the broader Nifty 50 benchmark even after an "explicit advisory" was issued to the firm in February 2025 by the National Stock Exchange of India.
"Such egregious behaviour, in clear disregard/ defiance of the explicit advisory issued to them by NSE in February 2025, amply demonstrates that unlike the vast majority of Foreign Portfolio Investors and other market participants, [Jane Street] Group is not a good faith actor that can be, or deserves to be, trusted," the regulator said.
"The integrity of the market, and the faith of millions of small investors and traders, can no longer be held hostage to the machinations of such an untrustworthy actor," SEBI added.
Deven Choksey, founder and managing director of wealth management firm DRChoksey FinServ, said SEBI's crackdown on Jane Street sets a "good example."
"Any player who is abusing the market requires to be shown the discipline. The regulator is doing their job for keeping intact the market integrity," he told CNBC.
While the execution of trades can be customized based on the needs and profile of the trader, price discovery in the market should be "universal for all," Choksey added.
Kranthi Bathini, director of equity strategy at WealthMills Securities, noted that some companies may "get into the market with creative and innovative strategies
44480916.article_summary: 印度证券交易委员会（SEBI）对美国公司Jane Street Group采取行动，指控其通过操纵印度的Nifty 50指数及其银行子指数BANKNIFTY进行市场操纵，非法获利约5.663亿美元。SEBI发布临时命令，冻结该金额并禁止Jane Street参与印度证券市场。Jane Street被指控在交易日初期大量买入相关股票和期货，随后卖出以压低指数，从中在期权市场获利。尽管Jane Street否认指控并表示将与监管机构合作，SEBI认为其行为缺乏经济合理性，严重影响了市场诚信和投资者信心。此举旨在保护零售投资者，维护市场公平。专家认为SEBI的行动树立了良好榜样，显示出对市场操纵行为的零容忍态度。

data.author: indigodaddy
data.article_summary: 该文章介绍了开源AI编码助手**opencode**，专为终端设计。它支持多种包管理器和操作系统安装，如macOS和Arch Linux。主要特性包括完全开源、不依赖特定供应商（兼容OpenAI、Google等）、专注于终端用户界面（TUI）、以及采用客户端/服务器架构，允许远程控制。开发者需使用Bun和Golang进行本地运行，并可通过修改TypeScript API实现功能扩展。项目鼓励通过GitHub issues讨论新功能，以确保贡献的有效性。此外，文章还对比了opencode与Claude Code的异同，并提供了社区和资源链接。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕终端用户界面（TUI）和AI编码工具的讨论，包括这些工具的功能、使用体验、定价以及与其他工具的对比。

不同观点：
• **反对TUI的观点**：jappgar认为TUI是一种倒退，只对那些对终端有情感依赖的人有吸引力。他认为TUI遮掩了过程和结果，目的是吸引更多人进入编码的付费陷阱。
• **支持TUI的观点**：jeremy_k分享了他使用OpenCode的积极体验，尤其是其反馈循环和自动化测试的能力，这在他使用Zed时无法实现。
• **对TUI持中立/探索态度的观点**：xrd认为TUI与Aider等工具类似，虽然他更喜欢命令行工具，但觉得目前还没有达到最佳状态，并提出是否能有一个通过自然语言控制和修改的编辑器的想法。

补充讨论：
• **关于工具定价和使用的讨论**：brainless询问了不同工具的定价模式，尤其是Claude Code在其订阅模式下的使用限制，并提到API成本问题。
• **开发者的回应**：thdxr作为开发者之一回应了社区的疑问，说明了项目的开发进度和未来计划，包括构建客户端/服务器模型和开发其他前端。
• **对项目和开发者的个人看法**：orliesaurus提到项目创建者喜欢引发网络争论以制造点击量，但同时也承认项目本身是有潜力的。
• **对项目名称和相似项目的关注**：preciz指出OpenCode与另一个项目名称相同，而zombot则提到缺乏配置本地Ollama模型的说明。
• **对工具对比的需求**：jauntywundrkind和adhamsalama都提到希望将OpenCode与Aider进行对比，而cranium则希望对比OpenCode和Claude Code的使用体验和性能。

争议焦点：
• TUI是否是一种进步还是倒退。
• 不同AI编码工具之间的功能和使用体验对比。
• 项目命名的冲突和配置说明的缺乏。

Documentation
For more info on how to configure opencode
head over to our docs
.
Contributing
For any new features we'd appreciate it if you could open an issue first to discuss what you'd like to implement. We're pretty responsive there and it'll save you from working on something that we don't end up using. No need to do this for simpler fixes.
Note
: Please talk to us via github issues before spending time working on
a new feature
To run opencode locally you need.
Bun
Golang 1.24.x
And run.
$ bun install
$ bun run packages/opencode/src/index.ts
Development Notes
API Client
: After making changes to the TypeScript API endpoints in
packages/opencode/src/server/server.ts
, you will need the opencode team to generate a new stainless sdk for the clients.
FAQ
How is this different than Claude Code?
It's very similar to Claude Code in terms of capability. Here are the key differences:
100% open source
Not coupled to any provider. Although Anthropic is recommended, opencode can be used with OpenAI, Google or even local models. As models evolve the gaps between them will close and pricing will drop so being provider agnostic is important.
A focus on TUI. opencode is built by neovim users and the creators of
terminal.shop
; we are going to push the limits of what's possible in the terminal.
A client/server architecture. This for example can allow opencode to run on your computer, while you can drive it remotely from a mobile app. Meaning that the TUI frontend is just one of the possible clients.
What's the other repo?
The other confusingly named repo has no relation to this one. You can
read the story behind it here
.

data.title: Lessons from 863 episodes of This American Life
data.author: cryzinger
data.article_summary: 本文作者分享了自己听完所有《This American Life》广播节目的经历，共计863集。作者提到，虽然耗时十年，但听速其实只是节目播出速度的三倍。起初，作者并无听完所有节目的计划，只是将其视为无尽的娱乐资源，直到几年前才意识到有可能听完。作者认为节目兼具高质量和创新性，每集围绕不同主题，故事类型多样，涵盖时事、个人历史、短篇小说、严肃新闻或轻松内容等。节目音乐和制作水准也一直出色，且敢于探讨有争议的话题。尽管是同一节目，但每次都有新鲜感和惊喜，使作者乐此不疲。此外，作者还观察到节目多年来不断精进，故事更具野心，参与人员更多，音乐选择也更丰富。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对《This American Life》 (TAL) 这一播客的多角度评价与讨论

不同观点：
• **正面评价**：
   - **文化与社会记录**：kiernanmcgowan 认为 TAL 是美国文化和社会的真实写照，可能成为未来人类学家和历史学家理解我们时代的重要来源。
   - **创作启发**：willturman 提到 TAL 主持人 Ira Glass 对创意过程的看法启发了他软件创作的思路。
   - **高质量内容**：adamgordonbell 热爱 TAL，并从中学习和借鉴，认为某些剧集能深刻改变听众的想法，同时提到该节目启发了许多其他节目和人才，如 David Sedaris。
   - **独特性和故事讲述**：js2 认为只有 The Moth 能与 TAL 相提并论，二者都以高质量的叙事见长。

• **负面评价**：
   - **内容失去吸引力**：RyJones 提到随着年龄增长，TAL 的内容变得不再有趣，认为 Ira Glass 在20年前就已脱离了“American Life”。
   - **声音问题**：comrade1234 表示尽管 TAL 的内容值得一听，但主持人Ira Glass的声音让他难以持续收听，类似的还有《Hidden Brain》。

• **节目形式与假设性讨论**：
   - **节目形式对比**：TMEHpodcast 提出一个假设性的问题，如果 TAL 是英国节目会怎样，并以幽默的方式描述了英式生活的平淡和谦逊。

• **技术性问题与建议**：
   - **播放速度争议**：teaearlgraycold 强烈反对以高于1倍的速度收听高质量内容，认为这是对内容的不尊重。
   - **技术警告**：xnx 提到网站有 HTTPS 警告。

• **节目内容扩展建议**：
   - **内容多样性不足**：seany 认为 TAL 是他尝试听但难以坚持听完的“最难以忍受的播客”，并建议增加一些关于扩大枪支权利、公共部门工会刑事化、或取消分区法等议题的严肃剧集。

补充讨论：
• **对技术工具的幽默评论**：pimlottc 幽默地提到他庆幸文章没有用 ChatGPT 来分析 TAL 的863集内容。
• **对剧情与现实对比的观察**：disposition2 提到通过回顾《Law & Order》剧情，可以观察到公民自由逐渐被侵蚀的现象，并与现实生活中的经历相对照。

争议焦点：
• **内容吸引力变化**：部分听众认为 TAL 随着时间推移失去了原有的吸引力，尤其是对于老听众来说。
• **播放速度的道德性**：有听众认为以快速播放高质量内容是不合适的，但这一观点并未得到普遍认同。

总结来看，评论围绕 TAL 的内容质量、主持人的声音表现、节目形式以及播放方式等多个方面展开了讨论，正面与负面评价兼有，并包含一些技术性和假设性的讨论。
